assisted by Mr. Bhupendra Singh Bisht, learned 
counsel for Nagar Palika Parishad.
4. The learned Senior Counsel representing 
the Nagar Pakika Parishad submits that it is a 
nazul land, and the District Magistrate has 
directed the Lake Development Authority to 
develop a parking lot. He would also say that 
the lands are very fragile lands and are highly 
susceptible to landslides.
5. In that view, we direct the petitioner to 
array the Lake Development Authority as party 
respondent. The petitioner is permitted to 
amend the cause title and file a fresh memo of 
parties by the end of the day.
6. List the matter on 25.09.2025.

16.10.2025 SPA No. 265 of 2025
Hon'ble G. Narendar, C.J.
Hon’ble Subhash Upadhyay, J.
Ms. Aarushi Batra, learned counsel for the appellant. 
2. Mr. P.C. Bisht, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel for the 
State of Uttarakhand / respondent Nos. 1 & 2. 
3. Ms Aananya Jain, learned counsel holding brief of Mr. Sandeep 
Kothari, learned counsel for respondent No. 4.
4. The matter has been listed on several dates and was listed even 
yesterday. Yesterday, the proceedings of the Chairman, Municipal 
Corporation, Nainital was placed. In the order dated 16.10.2025, this 
Court observed that Room No. 6 is unoccupied. The observations are not 
controverted. 
6. In that view, pending disposal of the writ petition, we direct the 
respondent-Municipal Corporation, Nainital to allot Room No. 6 to the 
appellant. The keys shall be handed over to the appellant by the 
respondent-Municipal Corporation 20.10.2025. 
7. We pass the order in view of the twin facts that the petitioner, 
who was in occupation of the property has been ousted from it and is a 
senior citizen and; that right to shelter is now in law recognized. 
8. Registry to communicate this order to the respondent-Municipal 
Corporation through e-mail forthwith. 
9. List this matter on 30.10.2025.
 (Subhash Upadhyay, J.) (G. Narendar, C.J.)
 16.10.2025 16.10.2025
Rathour
